Senses.Explanation: A paired term for stability and discernment. It occurs 962 times in 196 allowed texts. Huineng devotes a named section to it and gives the richest direct relation: 'Stability and discernment are one body, not two. Stability is the substance of discernment; discernment is the function of stability' (定慧一體，不是二。定是慧體，慧是定用). He continues, 'At the time of discernment, stability is in discernment; at the time of stability, discernment is in stability' (即慧之時定在慧，即定之時慧在定), then names this 'equal learning in stability and discernment.' He explicitly rejects making them successive: 'Do not say first stability produces discernment or first discernment produces stability as separate' (莫言先定發慧、先慧發定各別). Hongzhi pairs 'discernment able to be stable' with 'stability able to respond' (慧而能定。定而能應) and calls this 'the power of stability and discernment' (定慧力). Huangbo answers a question about their equal learning with 'throughout the twelve periods, do not rely on a single thing' (十二時中不依倚一物). A later letter supplies a corrective naming statement: 'Provisionally it is called stability and discernment; it is not an actual thing. As for this mind, it is originally self-stable and self-discerning' (方便喚作定慧，不是實法也。若論此心，本來自定自慧). Another record directly describes the graphs: inner and outer wholly clear is called stability, while responding to conditions and things with function without end is called discernment. The entry reports these corpus definitions without recasting the pair as a staged regimen.
Senses.Note: Direct definitions, substance/function equations, order contrasts, analogies, and corrective witnesses were all harvested. 'Equal stability and discernment' (定慧等) occurs 80 times in 44 texts; 'stability and discernment are one body' occurs in two independent texts; the substance/function formulas occur in four each. The pair remains one corpus-wide sense, led by Huineng's explicit rejection of separation and sequence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 我此法門，以定慧為本。大眾！勿迷，言定慧別。定慧一體，不是二。定是慧體，慧是定用。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Huineng, in the Platform Record of the Sixth Patriarch (六祖大師法寶壇經), directly states the one-body and substance/function relation of stability and discernment.

Occurrences.Kwic: 即慧之時定在慧，即定之時慧在定。若識此義，即是定慧等學。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Huineng, in the Platform Record of the Sixth Patriarch (六祖大師法寶壇經), continues the direct equation and names it equal learning in stability and discernment.

Occurrences.Kwic: 諸學道人，莫言先定發慧、先慧發定各別。作此見者，法有二相。口說善語，心中不善。空有定慧，定慧不等。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Huineng, in the Platform Record of the Sixth Patriarch (六祖大師法寶壇經), explicitly rejects treating stability and discernment as separate sequential productions.

Occurrences.Kwic: 慧而能定。定而能應。空有短長。初無欠剩。定慧力莊嚴。性相心齊證。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Hongzhi Zhengjue, in the Extensive Record of Chan Master Hongzhi (宏智禪師廣錄), pairs discernment able to be stable with stability able to respond, then names the power of stability and discernment.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師又別時問黃檗。定慧等學此理如何。黃檗云。十二時中不依倚一物。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Nanquan Puyuan, in the Jingde Record of the Transmission of the Lamp (景德傳燈錄), asks Huangbo Xiyun about equal learning in stability and discernment; Huangbo answers that throughout the twelve periods one does not rely on a single thing.

Occurrences.Kwic: 方便喚作定慧，不是實法也。若論此心，本來自定自慧。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Zongbao Daodu, in the Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Zongbao Daodu (宗寶道獨禪師語錄), calls the pair a provisional name rather than an actual thing and says mind is originally self-stable and self-discerning.

Occurrences.Kwic: 夫戒定慧者，乃法中之妙用也。佛祖雖嘗有言，而未達者有所執。今略而言之，庶資開悟。然其心境兩忘，一念不動曰戒。覺性圓明，內外瑩徹曰定。隨緣應物，妙用無窮曰慧。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Yongzheng Emperor, in the Imperially Selected Recorded Sayings (御選語錄), directly assigns separate predicates to precept, stability, and discernment.
